name: MultiAddons Bulk Product & Cart Discount for WooCommerce
author: multiaddons

sections.description:
MultiAddons Bulk Product & Cart Discount for WooCommerce lets store owners create flexible, rule-based pricing tiers that automatically apply discounts to products at the product and cart level.

Whether you want to reward bulk buyers, offer exclusive prices to specific user roles, or run time-limited promotions, this plugin gives you full control — without writing a single line of code.

Key Features

  • Discount Rules — Create unlimited discount rules (up to 2 in the free version) targeting specific products, categories, or your entire catalog.
  • Pricing Tiers — Set multiple quantity-based pricing tiers per rule (e.g., buy 1–4 at 10% off, buy 5+ at 20% off).
  • Pricing Types — Choose between a Fixed Discount (subtract a fixed amount from the product price) or a Percentage Discount per tier.
  • User Role Targeting — Restrict each pricing tier to specific WordPress user roles (e.g., Wholesale, Subscriber).
  • Specific User Targeting — Assign pricing tiers to individual customer accounts by username.
  • All Users Option — Apply a discount to all users regardless of role or account.
  • Product & Category Rules — Target specific products, specific categories, or all products in your store.
  • Exclude Products/Categories — Exclude specific products or categories from a rule.
  • Date Scheduling — Set optional start and end dates on each pricing tier for time-limited promotions.
  • Volume Pricing Table — A clear pricing table is automatically displayed on product pages so customers can see exactly how much they save at each quantity.
  • Priority System — Assign rule priorities so the correct rule is applied when multiple rules could match a product.
  • Enable/Disable Rules — Quickly enable or disable individual rules without deleting them.
  • HPOS Compatible — Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Block Compatible — Compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.

How It Works

  1. You create a Discount Rule and give it a name and priority.
  2. You choose which products or categories the rule applies to.
  3. You set one or more Pricing Tiers, each with a minimum quantity, optional maximum quantity, pricing type (fixed or percentage), and discount value.
  4. You optionally restrict each tier to specific user roles or customers.
  5. Customers automatically receive the correct discounted price on the product page and in the cart.

Free vs Pro

The free version supports up to 2 Discount Rules and up to 2 Pricing Tiers per rule. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited rules and tiers, along with advanced targeting and scheduling features.

Configuration & Usage

Step 1: Enable the Plugin

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Discount On Cart.
  2. Click the General Settings tab.
  3. Check Enable Discount Rules to activate the rule engine.
  4. Click Save Changes.

Step 2: Create a Discount Rule

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Discount Rules (appears in the left admin menu after enabling).
  2. Click Add New Discount Rule.
  3. Give your rule a title (e.g., “Bulk Buyers Discount”).
  4. Set a Priority number — lower numbers run first when multiple rules match a product.
  5. Choose Enable Rule to make it active.

Step 3: Select Target Products

In the Include Products/Categories section, choose one of:
* All Products — applies to every product in your store.
* Specific Products — search and select individual products.
* Specific Categories — search and select product categories.

Optionally, use the Exclude Products/Categories section to remove specific products or categories from the rule’s scope.

Step 4: Set Up Pricing Tiers

  1. Scroll to the Pricing Tiers section.
  2. Click + Add New Pricing Tier to add a tier.
  3. For each tier, configure:
    • Pricing Type — Fixed Price (deducts a flat amount from the product’s regular price) or Percentage (deducts a percentage of the regular price).
    • Value — The discount amount or percentage.
    • Min Qty — The minimum cart quantity for this tier to activate.
    • Max Qty — (Optional) The maximum quantity for this tier. Leave blank for no upper limit.
  4. Repeat to add more tiers for different quantity brackets.

Step 5: Set User Targeting (Optional)

Choose who receives the discount:
* All Users/Roles — Everyone gets the discount.
* User Role Based Pricing — Select one or more WordPress roles per tier.
* Username Based Pricing — Search and select specific customer accounts per tier.

Step 6: Set Dates (Optional)

Each tier supports optional Start Date and End Date fields. Leave blank to make the tier always active.

Step 7: Save

Click Publish (or Update) to save your rule. It takes effect immediately on the storefront.

Viewing the Result

  • On any targeted product page, customers will see a Volume Pricing table showing each tier’s quantity range, discounted price, and savings.
  • When customers add items to the cart, the discount is automatically applied to the cart price.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or greater
  • PHP 7.4 or greater

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for MultiAddons Bulk Product & Cart Discount for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. After installation completes, click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. The plugin will not run without it.

What is the difference between Fixed Price and Percentage discount?

  • Fixed Price: A flat amount is subtracted from the product’s regular price. For example, a Fixed Price discount of $5.00 on a $50.00 product makes the price $45.00.
  • Percentage: A percentage is deducted. For example, a 10% discount on a $50.00 product makes the price $45.00.

Can I target specific customers only?

Yes. In the Pricing Tiers section, select Username Based Pricing and search for the customer’s account.

Can I create time-limited discounts?

Yes. Each pricing tier has optional Start Date and End Date fields. The discount only applies within that date range.

How many rules can I create in the free version?

The free version supports up to 2 Discount Rules, each with up to 2 Pricing Tiers. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited rules and tiers.

Will this plugin conflict with WooCommerce sale prices?

The plugin reads the product’s regular price as the base for discount calculations, ensuring the discounted price is always calculated from the original price.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Improvement: Moved all inline CSS and JavaScript to dedicated enqueued files.
  • Improvement: Full input sanitization audit applied across all admin inputs.
  • Improvement: All functions, options, and globals now use plugin-specific prefixes to prevent naming collisions.
  • Fix: Section IDs in WooCommerce Settings now use unique identifiers to prevent option-saving conflicts.
  • Fix: Fixed Price discount type now correctly subtracts the discount value from the regular price.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
